_comment: The only per-repo file in this skill. SKILL.md and repos.md are identical
across every repo that uses /ai-dev — when you copy the skill to another
project, edit this file and nothing else.
'toolkit' is the shared UI library this repo consumes from sources via a
relative path. Set it to null in a repo that has no such dependency.
runInstructions: You may launch the app, but ONLY isolated. Every launch sets both variables:
TREEFACTS_LOCAL_DATA=/tmp/ai-dev/{key}
TREEFACTS_VAULT=/tmp/ai-dev/{key}/vault
TREEFACTS_LOCAL_DATA moves Electron's userData (and with it the single-instance
lock) to /tmp/ai-dev/{key}/electron, and the themes, UI-settings and layout files
out of ~/Library/Application Support/Darkness into /tmp/ai-dev/{key}.
TREEFACTS_VAULT is the notes vault. Without them a launch opens the maintainer's
REAL notes at ~/treefacts-db, whose 5-second autosave writes back whatever your
branch does to them, and collides with the maintainer's own running app. Never
launch without them, never point either at anything under your home directory,
and never run ./gradlew electron:run, scripts/run.sh or `npm start` with a bare
environment.
Build once (repeat after each change; append the -Plunula.toolkit.path property
your brief gives you, as on every Gradle call):
./gradlew :electron:npmInstall :electron:copyWebBundle :electron:copyMainBundle
Launch in the BACKGROUND (run_in_background, or `… &`) — it opens a desktop
window and blocks until quit:
cd electron && \
TREEFACTS_LOCAL_DATA=/tmp/ai-dev/{key} TREEFACTS_VAULT=/tmp/ai-dev/{key}/vault \
./node_modules/.bin/electron . --remote-debugging-port={port}
The directories are created for you. To start from seeded content instead of an
empty vault, run BEFORE launching:
python3 scripts/seed-vault.py --vault /tmp/ai-dev/{key}/vault
CHECK that the isolation took effect rather than assuming it. The main process
logs two lines at startup:
==> Vault: /tmp/ai-dev/{key}/vault (TREEFACTS_VAULT)
==> Data: /tmp/ai-dev/{key} (TREEFACTS_LOCAL_DATA)
If either line is absent, or names ~/treefacts-db or the Darkness folder, quit
the app at once, say so, and do not report the run as verification.
Drive it over CDP on port {port} as the /verify skill describes
(curl -s http://localhost:{port}/json, Runtime.evaluate, Page.captureScreenshot,
Input.dispatch*). Saved notes land as .md files under /tmp/ai-dev/{key}/vault.
Stop what you started: pkill -f -- "--remote-debugging-port={port}". That flag
is unique to your run, so it cannot reach another ticket's window or the
maintainer's app. Never pkill Electron or TreeFacts by name.
scripts/wipe-vault.sh and scripts/seed-vault.py take the vault path as an
argument; always pass /tmp/ai-dev/{key}/vault explicitly.
Also verify without the app wherever you can:
· The configured build, which compiles every target and runs the tests.
· Unit tests in client/src/commonTest (SubtreeCodecTest, PromotionPolicyTest,
InlineMarkdownTokenizerTest, …). Everything below the View layer is
commonMain, so prefer adding a test that pins the ticket's behaviour — it
is the strongest verification this repo can offer.
State in the PR's Verification section exactly which flows you exercised in the
running app and which you could not, and list what a human should still click
through.
